name: multiscroll
sourceLabelStatus: Long teacher pseudo-labels; not human ground truth
selection: real semantic loss + 0.5 compressed semantic loss
sampling: uniform scroll, uniform family, arclength within group; compaction donors from same scroll
limitations: Geometric material compaction, not calibrated mechanical simulation.
Validation uses a held-out scroll labelled by 358_finetuned_final; this measures teacher agreement, not independently verified fibre accuracy.
Intersection-dominated targets are ignored; intersection performance is not established.
